REMOVAL OF ENGINE
1. DRAIN COOLANT FROM RADIATOR AND CYLINDER BLOCK
2. REMOVE HOOD
3. REMOVE BATTERY
4. REMOVE WASHER TANK
5. REMOVE AIR CLEANER CASE, AIR FLOW METER AND AIR INTAKE CONNECTOR PIPE
6. REMOVE THROTTLE CABLE BRACKET FROM CYLINDER HEAD COVER (for A/T)
7. REMOVE ACCELERATOR AND ACTUATOR CABLE BRACKET FROM CYLINDER HEAD COVER
